notes: 'For this cause' splits under rule 45's closing clause and heads on 'for' because a Greek preposition is expressed; rule 46's postposition case is the contrast and would have headed on 'cause'.
s012 ten takes the supplied 'his' under rule 20's second arm: no genitive pronoun stands, and rule 76's availability test is satisfied since Iesous Christos is already spent on the subject names.
s018 mellonton heads on 'thereafter', the word carrying the lexeme's futurity, rather than on the relativizer or the modal 'should', which rules 9 and 17 exclude.
s004 'obtained mercy' heads on 'mercy' under rule 91, matching 1TI.1.13 in the same chapter.
